pitch: MULC connects {members} MacEwan students with the legal community through speaker nights, mock trials and networking. Partners get in front of motivated pre-law students early, and you'll always hear back from the club directly.

options.label: Option 1
options.title: Sponsor an event
options.body: Back one night that fits your firm: a speaker panel, mock trial, networking mixer or LSAT workshop.
perks: Your name and logo on the event page and posters
A few minutes to speak, or a table at the event

options.label: Option 2
options.title: General sponsorship
options.body: Support the club for the whole year and help keep events free for students.
perks: Logo at the top of the MULC home page
Recognition at every event this year

package.title: Sponsorship package 2026–2027
package.body: Everything in one PDF: who our members are, sponsorship tiers and perks, and this year's event calendar. Easy to forward to a partner at your firm.
